description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data, specifically for unit testing purposes within a testing framework. It includes a function to read a specified file into a memory buffer with error handling, and a function to print the content of that buffer alongside other data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling errors and null-termination.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file read into memory along with provided key-value pair data; calls read_file_into_memory and manages the output formatting.
